title: Department SSOT Governance Authority
purpose: Explicitly distinguish design authority from execution authority while making Department SSOTs mandatory for all modification activities.

governance.principle: Design authority and execution authority are complementary and intentionally separated.

rules: The Department SSOT SHALL be parsed before any department-owned modification.
Implementation SHALL conform to Department SSOT intent.
Registries SHALL be updated only after implementation satisfies Department SSOT requirements.
Audit SHALL verify resulting execution state.

normative_rules.text: Every governed department SHALL maintain a live Department SSOT.
Department SSOTs are living governance artifacts and SHALL be continuously updated as departmental architecture evolves.
Any agent performing implementation or maintenance within a department SHALL parse the current Department SSOT before proposing or applying changes.
Failure to consult the Department SSOT prior to modification SHALL constitute a governance violation.
Department SSOTs define design intent but do not directly establish executable state.
Executable state SHALL be determined exclusively from governed registries, validators, and approved audit artifacts.
Where Department SSOT intent and executable state diverge, the divergence SHALL be resolved through governed implementation and validation rather than reinterpretation of either artifact.
Department induction SHALL NOT occur until a live Department SSOT exists, because the SSOT is the canonical update authority for all future departmental modifications.

summary.agent_contract: Update agents consume both design truth and execution truth; runtime agents consume execution truth only.
